limitations.text: No warehouse inventory produced. (1) get_examples returned zero labelled examples for this AOI, so few_shot/concept_vector/linear_probe have no seeds. (2) zero_shot_text and vision_subagent are not configured. (3) imagery_window refused both gsi-seamless-aerial-japan and sentinel-2-l2a-cogs ("no imagery source"), so no image window could confirm any building. (4) The only index built is aef-10m-annual at 160 m cells (3430 cells, whole AOI ~9x7.7 km), chosen so a >=40 m building fits in a cell; the embeddings are synthetic fixtures, not real AlphaEarth. Embeddings alone cannot separate warehouses from factories, markets or hangars. I do not report a count; a guess would be unsupported. Coverage: the whole AOI was indexed but none of it was reviewed. Transfer: the workflow (embedding retrieval, then aerial verification) needs seeds and imagery. Neither is available here, so I cannot say it transfers from the training city. Expect extra false positives from factories and large industrial roofs in this Gifu/Aichi industrial area.

understanding.goal_restated: Find all warehouses (>=~1600 m2 logistics/storage buildings) in AOI near Gifu/Aichi border (136.72-136.82E, 35.38-35.45N) for 2024, as points with evidence, count range, and transfer notes.
